assumptions.statement: Positions, Lagna and vargas come from the Phase 5 Kundli (Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses).
Only the translated verses are followed; translator's notes are not used to fill a component.

authority_note: Verse-literal reference reading of BPHS Ch. 27 (Santhanam translation, OCR level); components whose method is not fixed by the verses are not evaluable, so no Shadbala total is produced.

reference.note: Debilitation points: the locked Phase 5 dignity table.

provenance.statement: (longitude - deep debilitation point), folded to <= 180 degrees, divided by 3

reference.note: The values are verse; 'compound relationships ... be seen in the Rasi chart only' is the translator's note. The verse says 'Moolatrikona Rasi' (a sign), while Ch. 3 v. 51-54 gives Moolatrikona as a degree range in the Rasi chart: a D1 placement in the Moolatrikona sign but outside the range is not evaluated.

provenance.statement: Moolatrikona 45, own 30, great friend 20, friend 15, equal 10, enemy 4, great enemy 2, in each of D1, D2, D3, D7, D9, D12, D30; compound relationship taken from the Rasi chart

reference.note: The note's '35 Virupas' contradicts the verse's quarter Rupa and is not used.

provenance.statement: 15 each for the Rasi and the Navamsa: Moon and Venus in even signs, the others in odd signs
Angle 60, succedent 30, cadent 15, by whole-sign house from the Lagna (the locked Vedic house baseline)

reference.locator: Ch. 27 v. 6 (printed p. 266); genders Ch. 3 v. 19 (printed p. 31)

provenance.statement: 15 to a male, female, neuter planet in the first, second, third 10-degree part

reference.note: The verse names the 4th, 7th and 10th houses and the ascendant; the translation glosses them as the Nadir, descendant and meridian, which are used (sidereal MC and MC + 180).

provenance.statement: (longitude - zero point), folded to <= 180 degrees, divided by 3; zero points: Nadir for Sun and Mars, descendant for Jupiter and Mercury, meridian for Venus and Moon, Ascendant for Saturn

reference.note: Apparent solar time from Swiss Ephemeris's equation of time (engineering). The note's 'simple method' disagrees with the verse and is not used.

provenance.statement: Unnata = apparent time from midnight (0-30 ghatis); Moon, Mars, Saturn get 2 x (30 - Unnata); Sun, Jupiter, Venus get 60 minus that; Mercury always 60

reference.note: The note's doubling of the Moon's Paksha Bala is not in the verse and is not applied; the doubled value is not reported.

provenance.statement: Benefics get (Moon - Sun, folded to <= 180) / 3; malefics get 60 minus that; benefic/malefic per the locked Phase 6 natural-nature standard

reference.note: Day = sunrise to sunset, night = sunset to sunrise (Phase 4 sunrise/sunset).

provenance.statement: 60 to Mercury, Sun, Saturn in the 1st, 2nd, 3rd third of the day; to Moon, Venus, Mars in the thirds of the night; Jupiter always 60

reference.note: The verse gives only the value. How the year lord is found exists only in the note (Surya Siddhanta ahargana via a translator's table), whose stated divisor (160) disagrees with its own worked example (360).

provenance.statement: Varsha (year) lord 15: NOT_EVALUABLE

reference.note: Month lord method only in the note, on the same unverified ahargana.

provenance.statement: Masa (month) lord 30: NOT_EVALUABLE

reference.note: The sunrise-to-sunrise day is also the locked Vara standard.

provenance.statement: 45 to the lord of the weekday, the day reckoned from sunrise

reference.note: Hora division only in the note (24 equal hours from sunrise, mean local time); no Pandit Ji Hora standard is locked yet (Phase 10).

provenance.statement: Hora lord 60: NOT_EVALUABLE

reference.locator: Ch. 27 v. 15-17 and note (printed p. 277 and the following tables)
reference.note: The verse's khanda procedure (45, 33, 12) and the note's declination formula (23 deg 27 min +/- kranti) x 1.2793 are different methods; the note also doubles the Sun's value, which the verse does not.

provenance.statement: Ayana Bala: NOT_EVALUABLE

reference.note: The chapter does not define when two planets are at war, and the adjustment uses the finished Shadbala of both planets.

provenance.statement: Yuddha (planetary war): NOT_EVALUABLE for Mars to Saturn; not applicable to the Sun and Moon

reference.note: v. 21-23 (eight kinds of motion, values partly illegible in the OCR) and v. 24-25 (Cheshta Kendra from the mean longitude and the sighrocca) are two methods; v. 24-25 needs mean elements the chapter does not supply.

provenance.statement: Moon: her Paksha Bala (v. 18). Sun: his Ayana Bala (NOT_EVALUABLE). Mars to Saturn: NOT_EVALUABLE
60/7 x (1 Saturn, 2 Mars, 3 Mercury, 4 Jupiter, 5 Venus, 6 Moon, 7 Sun)

reference.note: 'Reduce one fourth of the Drishti Pinda if a planet has malefic aspects ... add a fourth if aspected by a benefic ... super add the entire aspect of Mercury and Jupiter' does not fix one arithmetic; it also depends on Ch. 26 aspect values, which are themselves not evaluable in some cases (WP-C).

provenance.statement: Drik Bala: NOT_EVALUABLE

warnings: Moshier analytical ephemeris used (no Swiss Ephemeris data files configured)

no Shadbala Pinda is produced: Abda, Masa, Hora, Ayana, Yuddha, Drik and the Cheshta Bala of the Sun and of Mars to Saturn are not evaluable under BPHS Ch. 27 as read; evaluated_subtotal_virupas is a partial sum only
